english:
A Melee Attack with an extended lunge distance of 6 meters.

Arc Subclass Exclusive: has 2 Ability Charges.

Directly striking an enemy deals <pve 390 /> <pvp [100] /> damage, <arc Jolts /> them, and causes them to release chain lightning. Chain lightning deals <pve 265 /> <pvp [54] /> damage to enemies within 9 meters, chaining toward enemies up to a maximum of 5 times. It cannot chain to the most recently targeted enemy.

It releases two sets of chain lightning while <arc Amplified />, each targeting a different enemy, doubling the maximum amount of enemies hit. Enemies can still only be hit once by chain lightning.

source.text:
Melee Attack with an extended lunge distance of 6 meters.
Arc Subclass Exclusive: Has 2 Ability Charges.

Directly strikes an enemy, dealing 390 [100] damage, inflicting Jolt, and causing them to release chain lightning.
Chain lightning deals 265 [54] damage to enemies within 9 metres, chaining towards enemies up to a maximum of 5 times. Cannot chain to the most recently targeted enemy.

While Amplified:
Releases two sets of chain lightning, each targeting a different enemy, doubling the maximum amount of enemies hit. Enemies can still only be hit once by chain lightning.
Base Cooldown: 131.7 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.9x
